notes.title: 23.7.1 Update - Minimaps, New Menu System, and more!
notes.notes:

Added
New minimap system.
New Map Select Menu
New menu system and animations.
Blurred background for menu options
Background for Find servers
Animations for all menu options:
Bar in between settings buttons in the options
"Playing as: {Username}" in top left of multiplayer window to remind user their name

notes.title: Major Update! - 23.5.29
notes.notes:
Gear up, choose your beloved hero, and brace yourself for heart-pounding action in the BRAND NEW map - "The Data District"! Step into the realm of 2177 and fight off hordes of relentless zombies like never before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698624/b97dcaa196e5733cbf6b84c51f55d96fc75232fb.png


 New fog bounds added
 New 3d Menu
 New Characters Added!
 Voice lines when selecting characters
 New Power System


New Characters

Two thrilling additions have joined the fight! Meet Matthias, the enigmatic master of weaponry, and Sam, the nimble and cunning survivor. Choose your hero wisely and unleash their unique abilities as you battle your way through the zombie apocalypse. Each character comes with their own voice lines that bring them to life!


 Matthias
 Sam


New Map

Dive into a cybernetic landscape where neon-lit skyscrapers tower above the sprawling metropolis. Engage in heart-stopping combat amidst the remnants of a once-thriving civilization. Prepare to be awestruck by the unparalleled visuals and atmosphere that will transport you to a world like no other.


The Data District


New Power System

New Power System! Want to use perks? You'll need to activate the power in each level first! You'll need to find two fuses, and the two fuse boxes. Once you place the fuses, you can hit the master power switch to turn on all of the perk machines!

notes.title: 23.5.1 - "The Overseer" Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698624/c3ec54b5cea9493195e86ce7e8ca0287c659bffe.png


 Added loudspeakers installed by the Overseer. The Overseer taunts players as they attempt to reverse the damage he's done. (More voice lines coming soon. The Overseer will watch your progress and attempt to thwart your attempt at salvation.)
 Updated lobby to be more visually appealing. Added flashing street lights, headlights, swinging street signs, and more.
 Added day/night cycle. (10 minutes. Time speeds up as the time machine powers up.)
 Fixed Graphics Settings Menu. Settings now update live, allowing you to see the effects as you adjust them.
 Added game soundtrack folder.
 Added two new tracks. (Edited tracks for The Church and Motel maps.)
 Added visual barriers (for now). Replacing with gas soon.
 Updates to Church Map layout.
 Updated to menu scene layout in preparation for the new menu screen update.
 Added Electric Launcher wall buy to each stage. Will update to add new weapon types.
